english_description: A large, mature ES II-lineage wuxia MUD -- self-titled Ocean II but far better known in-game by its banner name, Star-Moon Legend (星月传奇) -- sharing engine lineage with this collection's es1_win, xkx2001, rzrmud, xo, Wuhan Station and Legend of the Yellow Emperor's Soul, and one of the more widely-circulated Chinese wuxia MUDs of its era (hymud, “Ocean V,” is its independent successor, sharing its own 191-domain map skeleton with hy5 rather than haiyang2's smaller one — see hy5's entry). A closer relative than that lineage list suggests: hy5 (Ocean 5) elsewhere in this collection has a byte-identical master.lpc and roughly 90% byte-identical domain files — effectively the same base world, extended with about 50 more zones (Vietnam, Korea, Japan, Tibet, Xinjiang) rather than an independent creation. Nearly 30,000 files build out a genuinely large world: sect-based jianghu with map regions spanning Jiangnan's water towns, the Mingjiao stronghold, Gaochang, and even a Japan zone, plus a full marriage system and gang/faction play layered on top of the standard skill and quest content.
